newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Kaiser to build new brewery in Ceara.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Kaiser to build new brewery in Ceara.

text.p: Brazilian beer maker Kaiser said it will invest 75 million reais ($73.4 million) over the next 15 months to build a new brewery in the northeastern state of Ceara to strenghten its position in the region.
The new plant, Kaiser's second in the northeast, will have a monthly output capacity of 10 million liters of beer and will be located in Pacatuba, the firm said in a statement.
Kaiser also plans to expand its brewery in the northeastern state of Bahia, it said.
These investments should allow the firm to lower distribution costs and expand market share in the northeast to 23 percent in 2000 from the current 6.8 percent in 1995, it added.
Brazil's third largest brewery, Kaiser has eight plants with total annual output reaching 140 billion liters.
